diagrams.title: From commercial buyer intent to settled recurring & CPA commissions
diagrams.subtitle: Five-stage high-ticket referral publishing & S2S attribution loop
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values indicate operating sequence; conversion and scrub rates vary by vertical.
diagrams.caption: Own the pre-sell comparison calculator, first-party click_id, and email relationship rather than sending cold clicks to raw vendor homepages.

stages.label: Intercept BOFU intent
stages.detail: Capture '[Vendor] vs [Vendor]', pricing-calculator, and migration queries across search, YouTube, and AI engines.

stages.label: Pre-sell & capture
stages.detail: Run an interactive edge fee/ROI calculator with above-the-fold FTC disclosure and optional checklist email capture.

stages.label: Mint S2S click_id
stages.detail: Log GCLID/UTM context in click_ledger and pass unique click_id into 3+ competing high-ticket merchant offers.

stages.label: Verify S2S & scrub
stages.detail: Ingest HMAC-signed PartnerStack, Impact, Everflow, or Ringba webhooks and hold a 15% reversal/scrub reserve.

stages.label: Compound & re-route
stages.detail: Upload net offline values to ad platforms, stack sequential fintech/SaaS bounties, and cap single merchants at <=25%.

diagrams.title: Bottom-of-funnel comparison traffic to net settled commissions
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative monthly cohort of 10,000 commercial-investigation visitors
diagrams.assumptions_note: Invented nested cohort counts illustrating high-intent B2B comparison math; not representative earnings.
diagrams.caption: Bottom-of-funnel switching and pricing queries convert 5x-10x higher than generic informational listicles.

stages.label: BOFU hub visitors
stages.detail: Visitors landing on '[Incumbent] pricing calculator', 'vs', and mid-year migration guides.

stages.label: Calculator / table users
stages.detail: Engaged buyers filtering vendor pricing tiers by seat count, state footprint, or transaction volume.

stages.label: Outbound merchant clicks
stages.detail: Pre-qualified clicks routed with first-party click_id across Primary, Runner-Up, and Fallback offers.

stages.label: Gross S2S conversions
stages.detail: Combined qualified B2B demos, funded fintech accounts, and recurring SaaS subscriptions reported.

stages.label: Settled post-scrub payouts
stages.detail: Locked payable conversions after 15% duplicate-CRM, invalid-lead, and 45-day cancellation scrubs.

diagrams.title: Gross reported commissions to net owner profit
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative $1,000 gross reported affiliate commission cohort
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD per $1,000 gross dashboard commissions; opening and closing bars are totals, middle bars are deductions.
diagrams.caption: Separate merchant GMV from gross reported commissions, deduct reversals first, and fund media/contractors out of settled Net EPC.

stages.label: Gross reported payouts
stages.detail: Initial CPA bounties, qualified call transfers, and recurring SaaS shares logged before locking.

stages.label: Scrubs & clawbacks
stages.detail: 15% duplicate-CRM leads, <45-day trial cancellations, and refund/chargeback reversals.

stages.label: Paid media & co-reg
stages.detail: Bounded exact-match comparison search and SparkLoop co-reg spend net of Day-0 recoup.

stages.label: Editorial & video pod
stages.detail: Two specialized part-time contractors producing substantiated guides, calculators, and YouTube demos.

stages.label: Edge, S2S & compliance
stages.detail: ClickFlare/Everflow S2S tracking, Ringba routing, SERP/GEO intelligence, and substantiation ops.

stages.label: Owner net profit
stages.detail: 35.1% Base-Case net margin on $850 net earned commissions (20% Conservative -> 50% Scaled).

diagrams.title: Illustrative net commission per conversion across referral rails
diagrams.subtitle: Typical post-scrub USD realization per qualified conversion event
diagrams.assumptions_note: Illustrative midpoints across B2B/fintech/lead-gen rails; verify live partner contracts independently.
diagrams.caption: High-ticket B2B SaaS, stacked fintech bounties, and 90-second inbound calls dwarf 1%-4% retail affiliate links.

stages.label: Stacked B2B Fintech + SaaS
stages.detail: Sequential LLC + business banking + corporate card + payroll software bounties on one new entity.

stages.label: B2B SaaS 30% RevShare (12m)
stages.detail: 12-month realized recurring share on a $210/mo B2B software plan net of logo churn.

stages.label: Enterprise Demo + Won CPA
stages.detail: Blended PartnerStack / Impact payout combining qualified SQL demo fee plus closed-won bonus.

stages.label: Inbound Pay-Per-Call (90s+)
stages.detail: Ringba/Phonexa qualified commercial insurance, legal, or home-service call lasting >=90 seconds.

stages.label: Retail E-Commerce Cookie
stages.detail: 3% commission on a $200 consumer cart exposed to 24-hour cookie expiry and coupon poaching.

diagrams.title: Disclosure, trademark, TCPA & concentration guardrails
diagrams.subtitle: Mandatory pre-flight checks before activating traffic on any offer
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numbers identify sequential operating checks enforced prior to live click routing.
diagrams.caption: Eliminate retro-clawbacks and account bans by enforcing FTC disclosures, TM+ riders, S2S deduplication, and <=25% merchant caps.

stages.label: FTC 255 above fold?
stages.detail: Plain-English material connection notice appears above first CTA on 390px mobile, desktop, and video.

stages.label: TM+ or brand negs?
stages.detail: Either signed written TM+ co-bidding addendum on file or account-level partner brand negatives active.

stages.label: TCPA / statutory clean?
stages.detail: Zero federal healthcare % kickbacks (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b); Seller-specific consent + TrustedForm on calls/leads.

stages.label: S2S + <=25% cap?
stages.detail: HMAC S2S postback verified with >=2 fallback offers live so no merchant exceeds 25% of portfolio revenue.

diagrams.title: One full-time founder, two specialized contractors
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative 3-person ($325k earned-commission Base Case) pod
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are role identifiers; Scaled ($600k earned commissions) scenario expands to 2 FT + 3 C.
diagrams.caption: Keep fixed payroll near zero by pairing founder deal/attribution ownership with specialized research and video contractors.

stages.label: Founder / deal & media lead
stages.detail: Owns merchant underwriting, private CPA bumps, S2S ledger ops, exact-match search caps, and capital float.

stages.label: B2B research & hub editor
stages.detail: Publishes substantiated comparison calculators, maintains 30-day pricing archives, and optimizes GEO tables.

stages.label: YouTube & link-QA specialist
stages.detail: Produces 2 screen-recorded product comparisons weekly, manages SparkLoop co-reg, and audits S2S link health.

diagrams.title: Disciplined $20,000 hybrid high-ticket affiliate launch budget
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative allocation across Candidate #24's $5k-$50k startup range
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD cash allocation; >=60% stays in liquid Net-60 payout float and working-capital reserve.
diagrams.caption: Edge comparison hubs cost pennies to host; preserve the majority of launch capital to bridge Net-45/Net-60 commission locking windows.

stages.label: Entity, clean domains & IP
stages.detail: LLC setup, dedicated bank/cards, non-trademark domain diligence, and 17 U.S.C. 204(a) contractor agreements.

stages.label: Edge, S2S & SERP/GEO stack
stages.detail: Three months of Cloudflare Workers/D1, ClickFlare/Everflow S2S tracker, Ringba numbers, and SERP data.

stages.label: Bounded BOFU & co-reg tests
stages.detail: Capped exact-match comparison search tests, SparkLoop co-reg seed budget, and initial video editing.

stages.label: Net-60 float & cash reserve
stages.detail: Segregated working-capital buffer bridging 30-day ad-card billing against 45-to-60-day merchant ACH payouts.

diagrams.title: Thirty days from partner approval to verified Net EPC run-rate
diagrams.subtitle: Four weekly underwriting, S2S build, BOFU launch & Kill/Fix/Scale phases
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 3-12 month ramp applies to compounded organic/recurring cohorts.
diagrams.caption: Validate conversion rate and Net EPC on bottom-of-funnel comparison intent in Month 1 before scaling content headcount.

stages.label: Underwrite & approve
stages.detail: Approve >=3 competing offers in 1 B2B/fintech vertical, audit clawback/TM+ terms, and map 25 BOFU queries.

stages.label: Wire calculator & S2S
stages.detail: Ship <1s edge comparison calculator, FTC 255 bar, checklist capture, and synthetic S2S webhook test.

stages.label: Launch guides & video
stages.detail: Publish 10 substantiated vs/pricing pages, 5 YouTube demos, and run a $300-$500 exact-match search test.

stages.label: Reconcile & scale
stages.detail: Audit scrub reasons, negotiate a 20%-30% private CPA bump on early volume, and apply Kill/Fix/Scale rules.
